latest.headline: Mannat turns into a screen: a projector test pattern lights up SRK's home the night before he turns 61
latest.deck: A giant white screen now wraps the tower behind Mannat's heritage bungalow, and fan videos from the night of 31 Oct show a projector calibration grid and colour bars across it, with a projector rig on the bungalow roof. Nobody official has said what will play on it. At 14:12 IST today SRK posted the other half of the birthday light show himself: the Bandra-Worli Sea Link lit with his face and '2 DAYS TO GO', with Google Gemini.
latest.quote: Dost ho toh Google Gemini jaisa.. Thank you for the KING-sized love always.... had to sneak out for a drive to get this photo ha ha..
latest.image_alt: Mannat at night: a projector calibration grid with red, green, blue and white bars on the giant screen wrapping the tower behind the bungalow; the Mannat gate pillar in front
